many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for i,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg)
    col,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==col]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # largest axis-aligned rectangle fully covered by col inside bbox
    best=[]
    import itertools
    for r_a in range(r0,r1+1):
        for r_b in range(r_a,r1+1):
            for c_a in range(c0,c1+1):
                for c_b in range(c_a,c1+1):
                    if all(g[i][j]==col for i in range(r_a,r_b+1) for j in range(c_a,c_b+1)):
                        best.append((len(range(r_a,r_b+1))*len(range(c_a,c_b+1)),r_a,r_b,c_a,c_b))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    area,r_a,r_b,c_a,c_b=best[0]
    return [[col if (r_a<=i<=r_b and c_a<=j<=c_b) else bg for j in range(len(g[0]))] for i in range(len(g))]
d_in=G['Demo pair 1 input']
out=solve(d_in)
print(out==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
t=solve(G['Test input'])
for r in t: print(r)
